turns.doctor_question: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you into the clinic today?
turns.patient_response:
Thank you, Doctor. I really appreciate you seeing me. Um, I hope I'm not wasting your time, I just... well, I want to make sure I'm doing the right thing by being here. 

It's a little embarrassing to talk about, to be honest, because I don't want you to think poorly of me. But... I've been hearing things. Very clear voices. Mostly just in my apartment, or sometimes when I'm out at a museum and happen to be in an empty room. It sounds like... like women whispering from right behind the walls. They tell me which photographs belong in the archive. 

I know how strange that must sound, I'm so sorry. Does... does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it okay for you.

turns.doctor_question: Looking back over these past eight months, would you say you felt that low and uninterested feeling for most of the time, or was it only for a small part of it?
turns.patient_response:
Oh, well... I really hope I'm not making things too complicated for you. I want to give you a clear answer, I really do. But... to be completely honest, since I retired, the low feelings haven't actually been the main thing. 

I feel a bit silly saying this, because I know I just went on and on about the herb pots and not calling people back. But for most of these past eight months, it's actually been quite the opposite. I've had these long stretches where I feel... well, incredibly driven. Almost like I've been chosen for something important. I just couldn't seem to slow down, and... I'm so sorry to admit this, but I got quite irritable with people who couldn't keep up with me. 

Even on the days when I felt a bit more withdrawn, that driven, restless feeling was still kind of... running the show, if that makes sense. I hope it's alright that I'm correcting myself like this.
